Subject: SummitTech SIG questionnaire and evidence ask

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks again for taking our call yesterday. As discussed, our procurement and security teams have a SIG questionnaire and a set of follow-up evidence asks covering SOC 2/ISO controls and third-party dependencies. I attached the questionnaire (tabbed) — we grouped items we need within the next two weeks under the "Critical" tab.

Two quick asks up front:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood provides customer-facing evidence for key ops controls (backup verification, key rotation logs, privileged access reviews)?
- Who at Redwood will own the evidence delivery and point-of-contact for follow-up clarifications?

We're targeting a 2027-01-04 vendor decision; having a mapped control-responsibility document + artifacts would help speed the review.

Appreciate it — Andre

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitTech SIG questionnaire and evidence ask

Andre —

Thanks for sharing the questionnaire and the deadline context. We can support a two-part deliverable: (1) a control mapping spreadsheet showing where Redwood's controls meet each SIG item and which artifacts substantiate that mapping and (2) a package of artifacts (logs, configurations, policy excerpts) accessible via a shared Drive folder.

To be concrete:
- Point-of-contact: Nikhil Sharma (security intake lead) — primary for clarifications; Marissa Cole will lead artifact collection; Jonas Weber will validate infra/ops evidence.
- Timeline proposal: initial control mapping + index by 2026-12-22, artifact staging folder available by 2026-12-29, final package by 2027-01-03.
- Evidence scope: SOC 2 (security/process), ISO 27001 mappings, and SIG-specific vendor-control tie-outs. Where customer-facing artifacts are restricted (e.g., third-party contracts), we will provide redacted extracts and attestations.

Two quick questions from our side:
1) Which SIG tab(s) are highest priority for your reviewers? (Critical vs. High vs. Medium)
2) Any shared controls scope (e.g., if you plan to host in your VPC) we should factor in?

I attached a short control-summary template we plan to use (helps speed review). If that works, we'll send the mapping by the 22nd.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: SummitTech SIG - artifact owners and sprint plan

Team — quick internal coordination to meet the SummitTech timeline. Summary of our plan: 

1) Owners and asks
- Marissa: collect governance artifacts (policies, SOC 2 report excerpts, ISO cert statement)
- Jonas: ops evidence (backup proofs, rotation schedules, infra change logs, runbook excerpts)
- Mina: identity/privileged access artifacts (user access review logs, PAM configuration screenshots)
- Nikhil: QA on mapping + liaison with Summit security team

2) Artifact template and redaction rules
- Use the Requested_Control_Summary.docx as the standard mapping row; include a quick attestation field when full artifacts cannot be shared.
- Redact personal identifiers and customer names; mark redactions in the index.

3) Delivery cadence
- Draft mapping to Nikhil by EOD 2026-12-22 (Jonas to flag any infra gaps)
- Staging folder live 2026-12-27 with incremental uploads
- Final package including index and redaction notes by 2027-01-03

4) Risks and escalations
- SOC 2 full report has an NDA gate — if Summit needs the full report we will request an NDA execution; otherwise we'll provide SOC 2 summary extracts and the SOC bridge letter.
- Third-party contract redactions may take extra legal review time; flagging now so we can prioritize.

I'll start the Drive folder and share a link once the first artifacts are uploaded. Ping me if you want to reassign owners.

—Marissa
Director, Assurance Operations
Redwood Inference
